rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR PEOPLE'S INITIATIVE TO AMEND THE CONSTITUTION
rows.title_short: \"People's Initiative to Amend the Constitution Act of 2006\"
rows.abstract: \"People's Initiative to Amend the Constitution Act of 2006\".  The bill provides for amendments to the Constitution to be directly proposed by the people through initiative upon the petition of at least 12% of the total number of registered voters of which every legislative district must be represented by at least three (3%) percent of the registered voters therein.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE OPERATION OF CELLULAR MOBILE TELEPHONE SERVICES TO PROTECT THE RIGHTS OF CELLULAR PHONE SUBSCRIBERS
rows.title_short: \"Cellular Phone Subscribers Protection Act of 2005.\"
rows.abstract: \"Cellular Phone Subscribers Protection Act of 2005\".  The bill seeks the creation of a Subscribers' Protection Unit in the National Telecommunications Commission where subscribers can air and file their complaints.  It also seeks a longer period of validity of SIM cards from two months to 12 months.
rows.status: Business for the day on 2006-03-06

rows.author: C079
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE AND GOVERN THE DEVELOPMENT OF VOICE OVER INTERNET PROTOCOL IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: \"Philippine VOIP Act of 2005.\"
rows.abstract: \"Philippine VOIP Act of 2005\".  The bill requires any person or entity seeking to provide VOIP (voice over internet protocol) services for the use of the public to register with the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) prior to operation.  It also directs the NTC to determine interconnection access rates.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2006-05-29, transmitted to on 2006-05-31 and received by the Senate on 2006-05-31

second_reading.remarks: On April 05, 2006, the Body approved to consider the Explanatory Note of the Bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure.
